Context: - OM, dated 6-4-201'8.

16. Central Government employees on short-term deputation to SB/AB will be allowed to avail CGHS facilities during their tenure of deputation. They can opt for medical facilities provided by CGHS or by the organization. - OM, dated 9-6-2014.
17. Defence Industrial Employees of Naval Dock Yard, Central Ordnance Depot and AFMSD can avail CGHS facilities in Mumbai at par with the Defence Industrial employees. - OM, dated 21-4-2017.
